name: temperature
description: Workspace do projeto Temperature e seus servidores MCP.

scripts.build: npm run build:mcp && tsc -p tsconfig.backend.json && vite build
scripts.dev: npm run build:mcp && concurrently -k -n api,ui "tsx watch src/backend/index.ts" "vite --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace temperature-mcp && tsc -p tsconfig.backend.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.frontend.json
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace temperature-mcp && tsx --test src/backend/*.test.ts src/frontend/*.test.ts
